verdict.rationale: Codex is documented as a general coding agent that can inspect code, edit files, run local dev tools, and produce diffs/PRs, which implicitly covers writing tests, fixing lint errors, resolving conflicts, and updating dependencies as generic coding tasks, and community evidence confirms it does real code-fixing work in practice (e.g. 'it fixes everything in 3 minutes'). However, there is no explicit documentation or example specifically calling out test-writing, lint-fixing, merge-conflict resolution, or dependency updates as named capabilities, and some hands-on reports note inconsistent quality/struggles. Missing for 10: explicit docs/examples naming test generation, lint-fixing, merge-conflict resolution, and dependency updates as first-class supported workflows.
